method: Separate script: sklearn f1_score recount of Cov30 for the H3.2 cells from stored signs/thresholds, brute-force threshold search reproducing stored development F1 for one SAE run, H3.2 re-derived; negative control: label-permuted fact oracle.
limitations: Same author and session (not independent replication); MIG, DCI and the activation substrate are not recomputed.
